access.login_failure.title: Cannot log in with correct password
access.login_failure.description: Users report the app rejects their password and blocks access to their account.

billing.premium_only_controls.title: Basic playback controls locked behind premium
billing.premium_only_controls.description: Users say skipping, queue control, and song selection were moved behind the premium subscription in a recent update.

catalog.lyrics.title: Lyrics missing for some songs
catalog.lyrics.description: Users report lyrics sometimes fail to appear, with inconsistent availability across songs.

catalog.missing_or_removed_content.title: Many songs and genres unavailable
catalog.missing_or_removed_content.description: Users feel the catalog lacks many songs, including certain genres like gospel music.

catalog.recommendations.title: Recommendations feel unwanted or worse
catalog.recommendations.description: Users dislike the app's recommendations, saying they are excessive or have declined in quality.

downloads.download_failure.title: Song downloads get stuck in background
downloads.download_failure.description: Downloads stall in the background and only resume when the app is opened.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Offline mode does not work
downloads.offline_mode.description: A user reports that offline mode is not functioning.

other.boycott_political.title: Users boycotting app over political issues
other.boycott_political.description: Users say they will uninstall or boycott the app over its country of origin and related political controversies.

other.general_criticism.title: Vague general dissatisfaction with app
other.general_criticism.description: Users express broad negative sentiment without naming a specific problem.

playback.audio_quality.title: Music adjustment settings not working properly
playback.audio_quality.description: A user reports that music adjustment controls do not function correctly.

playback.connection_errors.title: App fails to connect over Wi-Fi
playback.connection_errors.description: Premium user reports the app cannot connect to the internet on Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some song quality is poor.

playback.crashes_or_wont_open.title: App crashes or stalls at launch
playback.crashes_or_wont_open.description: Users report the app gets stuck on the loading screen or crashes after an update, preventing it from opening.

playback.device_connectivity.title: Google Assistant playback not working
playback.device_connectivity.description: Google Assistant says it is playing a Spotify playlist but does not actually play the songs.

playback.stops_or_skips.title: Playback stops midway and jumps tracks
playback.stops_or_skips.description: Music keeps stopping halfway through and does not resume where it left off, starting a new song instead.

usability.ads.title: Too many ads for free users
usability.ads.description: Free users say ads play very frequently, sometimes every one or two songs, and are loud, making the app frustrating to use.

usability.redesign_update.title: Unwanted redesign and autoplay changes
usability.redesign_update.description: Users dislike the new homescreen and update, including losing the ability to skip back a few seconds and large auto-playing audio elements with no way to disable them.

usability.shuffle_autoplay.title: Shuffle plays songs out of order
usability.shuffle_autoplay.description: Users report they can only skip a limited number of tracks and that playlists play songs randomly rather than as expected.
